tools.name: find_events_near
tools.description: Find medieval events near a geographic location. Returns events sorted by distance.

params.name: types
params.description: Filter by event type. Omit for all types.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List medieval events filtered by category, country, and/or date range.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. DE, AT, CH, FR)

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get full details for a single event by its ID.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search historical recipes (13th–17th century) by course, difficulty, ingredients, and other criteria.

params.name: course
params.description: Course type. Atomic values: starter, main_beef, main_pork, main_poultry, main_game, main_fish, main_other, side, dessert, drink, condiment, other. Aliases: main = all main courses (meat + fish + other

params.name: epoch_to
params.description: Latest historical year of the source (e.g. 1450)

params.name: epoch_from
params.description: Earliest historical year of the source (e.g. 1350)

params.name: ingredients
params.description: Include filter: all listed ingredients must be present (AND, partial match). E.g. ["Zimt", "Macis"]. German ingredient names preferred.

params.name: lagerkueche
params.description: If true, only return recipes suitable for outdoor camp cooking

params.name: exclude_courses
params.description: Exclude these course types. E.g. ["main_fish"] to skip fish mains. main_meat excludes all meat courses; main excludes all main courses.

params.name: exclude_ingredients
params.description: Exclude recipes that contain any of these ingredients (partial match). E.g. ["Ingwer"] to skip ginger dishes. German names preferred.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get the full details of a single recipe including ingredients, annotations, FAQ, and original transcript.

tools.name: compose_menu
tools.description: Compose a multi-course menu from historical recipes. Minimizes ingredient overlap between courses. Returns one recipe per course.

params.name: courses
params.description: Ordered list of courses, e.g. ["starter", "main_poultry", "dessert"]. Course type. Atomic values: starter, main_beef, main_pork, main_poultry, main_game, main_fish, main_other, side, dessert, drink, c

params.name: persons
params.description: Number of persons (informational, returned in output)

params.name: lagerkueche
params.description: If true, only use camp-cooking-suitable recipes

tools.name: list_recipe_sources
tools.description: List all available historical recipe sources with year, region, language, and recipe count. Also returns the full course taxonomy (atomic values + aliases) so you can use granular filters like main_poultry, main_pork, main_game in search_recipes and compose_menu.

tools.name: find_pois_near
tools.description: Find permanent medieval-themed locations (meaderies, castles, restaurants) near a geographic point.

params.name: poi_type
params.description: POI type: meadery/metkellerei (mead producers), burg (castle), ma_gastronomie (medieval restaurant)
